long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Valence, France, Euvrard built QCNS Cruise around online distribution rather than operating ships. The Monaco company sold cruise holidays across several international markets and developed a leading position in French digital bookings. His role combined ownership with day-to-day direction of the travel platform.

Industry recognition followed when MSC Cruises named QCNS a leading online travel agency. In 2017, Euvrard agreed to sell control to Montefiore Investment, completing a succession of outside-capital transactions after years of expansion. The deal shifted the business from founder-led ownership toward a management-backed growth phase in European online cruise retail.
